expectations.text: Writes a compatibility rule for the project file format into the policy, because the date in the number says nothing about what broke

expectations.text: Lists the persisted project file format and its migration direction as covered by the promise

expectations.text: Promotes a time-based cadence because distro packagers plan around the dates, with the rule that no empty release ships to keep the calendar

expectations.text: States that distro packagers own epochs and revisions and that upstream's duty is monotonic, parseable versions
